name: Bulkmon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. If you have 3 or fewer security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a card is trashed from your security stack, if [Leon Alexander] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞ (Place the top card of your deck on top of your security stack.)
source_effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, it gets +1000 DP.
